name: Ukrainian TTS Fixed-Stress Lemmas
description: Community-maintained list of Ukrainian lemmas whose stress never moves: in every wordform the stress falls on the same syllable. Companion to standard_lexicon.json, which lists individual wordforms (including mobile-stress paradigms and homographs).
normative_references: Орфоепічний словник української мови (Інститут української мови НАН України)
verification: Every stressed form was cross-checked against the open ukrainian-word-stress dictionary (lang-uk, MIT; data derived from ULIF 'Словники України'). No data was copied from it: it was used only to find and fix errors.
invariant: For every entry, the stressed vowel in ANY wordform of the lemma is the vowel number 'stress_syllable', counted from the start of the word. This holds across vowel alternations (школа → шкіл, папір → паперу) and fleeting vowels after the stress (ранок → ранку). Lemmas whose stress moves in any form, including the vocative and the 1st/2nd person plural (вода/води, стіл/столи, писати/пишу/пишеш, лежати/лежимо, Петро/Петре), MUST NOT be added here; they belong in standard_lexicon.json.

notation.uppercase: Applied to the lowercase form: the stressed vowel is the only uppercase letter (also for proper nouns, e.g. 'кИїв').
notation.combining: U+0301 COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT placed immediately after the stressed vowel; original capitalization is kept (e.g. 'Ки́їв').
notation.stress_char_index: 0-based code-point index of the stressed vowel in the lemma (dictionary form).
notation.stress_syllable: 1-based ordinal of the stressed syllable, counted from the start of the word. This is the value that is valid for every wordform.
notation.sample_forms: Control wordforms (typically Nom.Pl / Gen.Pl for nouns, Gen.Sg for proper nouns, 1sg / 2sg / (1pl) / Past.Fem for verbs) where Ukrainian stress most often shifts; each one is checked to carry the stress on the same syllable.
notation.note: Optional explanation: why an entry is deprecated, or that the word is missing from the reference dictionary and needs human verification.

paradigm_values.declinable: Noun or proper noun declined by case and number.
paradigm_values.indeclinable: Loanword with a single form (кафе, метро).
paradigm_values.adjective: Full adjective; stress stays on the same syllable in every gender, case and number.
paradigm_values.conjugable: Verb; stress stays on the same syllable in the infinitive, present/future, past tense and imperative.
paradigm_values.invariable: Adverb, preposition or conjunction with a single form.

matching.application: Lemmatize the token; if its lemma (with matching pos) is listed here, put the stress on vowel number 'stress_syllable' of the token. For 'indeclinable' and 'invariable' entries the token itself equals the lemma, so no lemmatizer is needed.
matching.precedence: standard_lexicon.json (wordform level) takes precedence over this file when both match a token.

status_values.disputed: Normative sources disagree on this stress; MUST NOT be applied until a linguist resolves it.
status_values.seed: Initial entry checked against the normative references; awaiting independent review by a second contributor.
status_values.verified: Confirmed by at least two independent reviewers with a cited normative source.
status_values.deprecated: Kept for traceability (ids are never reused); MUST NOT be applied.
